potionRule.ExplosivePotion: Deal damage equal to potency to all enemies (base 10).
potionRule.Elixir: Choose any number of cards in your hand to Exhaust.
potionRule.AttackPotion: Choose one of three generated Attack cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.SkillPotion: Choose one of three generated Skill cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.PowerPotion: Choose one of three generated Power cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.ColorlessPotion: Choose one of three generated Colorless cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); the chosen card costs 0 this turn. This choice cannot be skipped.
potionRule.StrengthPotion: Gain Strength equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.BloodPotion: Heal for potency percent of max HP (base 20%), rounded down when used; actual healing cannot exceed missing HP.
potionRule.HeartOfIron: Gain Metallicize equal to potency for this combat (base 6).
potionRule.DuplicationPotion: This turn, each of the next potency cards you play is played twice (base 1). Applies to any card type, not only Attacks; unused charges expire at turn end.
potionRule.BlessingOfTheForge: Upgrade all cards currently in your hand for this combat.
potionRule.FirePotion: Deal damage equal to potency to one enemy (base 20).
potionRule.PoisonPotion: Apply Poison equal to potency to one enemy (base 6). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.WeakenPotion: Apply Weak equal to potency to one enemy (base 3). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.FearPotion: Apply Vulnerable equal to potency to one enemy (base 3). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.EnergyPotion: Gain Energy equal to potency this turn (base 2).
potionRule.DexterityPotion: Gain Dexterity equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.SpeedPotion: Gain Dexterity equal to potency (base 5), then apply an equal Dexterity Down debuff that removes it at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
potionRule.SteroidPotion: Gain Strength equal to potency (base 5), then apply an equal Lose Strength debuff that removes it at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
potionRule.FocusPotion: Gain Focus equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.BottledMiracle: Add Miracles equal to potency to your hand (base 2). A Miracle costs 0, gives 1 Energy and Exhausts; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.AncientPotion: Gain Artifact equal to potency (base 1). Each charge blocks one incoming debuff, including a temporary buff's removal debuff if it is applied afterward.
potionRule.RegenPotion: Gain Regeneration equal to potency (base 5). At each player turn end, heal for the current stacks, then lose 1 stack; healing restrictions and the HP cap apply.
potionRule.EssenceOfSteel: Gain Plated Armor equal to potency (base 4). It grants that much Block at player turn end and loses 1 stack when an enemy Attack causes unblocked HP loss.
potionRule.LiquidBronze: Gain Thorns equal to potency for this combat (base 3). It damages an attacker for that amount whenever you are attacked, even if the hit is blocked.
potionRule.DistilledChaosPotion: Play the next potency cards from the top of your draw pile without paying their energy costs (base 3). Enemy targets are random; normal card effects and play restrictions still apply.
potionRule.CunningPotion: Add upgraded Shivs equal to potency to your hand (base 3). Each Shiv+ costs 0, deals 6 base damage and Exhausts; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.PotionOfCapacity: Gain Orb slots equal to potency (base 2).
potionRule.LiquidMemories: Choose potency cards from your discard pile to return to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. If fewer cards are available, return the available cards; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.GamblersBrew: Choose any number of cards from your hand to discard, then draw that many cards. You may choose none; draw prevention and hand capacity still apply.
potionRule.StancePotion: Choose to enter Wrath or Calm. Wrath doubles Attack damage dealt and received; leaving Calm grants Energy under the current stance rules.
potionRule.FairyPotion: Passive: when lethal HP loss occurs, consume this potion and heal for 30% of Max HP (60% with Sacred Bark), rounded down with a minimum request of 1 HP. Cannot be used manually. Mark of the Bloom prevents this revival.
potionRule.SmokeBomb: Escape the current non-boss combat instead of winning it; no combat rewards are earned. Cannot be used against bosses or while the Spire Shield and Spire Spear surround you.
potionRule.FruitJuice: Gain Max HP equal to potency and request the same amount of healing (base 5). May be used outside combat; healing restrictions still apply.
potionRule.EntropicBrew: Consume this potion, then generate random potions to fill empty slots, including its freed slot. Potions already held remain. Sozu prevents obtaining the generated potions.
potionRule.SneckoOil: Draw cards equal to potency (base 5), then randomize eligible costs of all cards in your hand to 0-3. X-cost and negative unplayable costs are excluded.
potionRule.GhostInAJar: Gain Intangible equal to potency (base 1), reducing incoming damage and HP loss to 1 per instance while active.
potionRule.CultistPotion: Gain Ritual equal to potency (base 1). Gain that much Strength at the end of each player turn, including the turn it is used; it does not grant Strength immediately on use.
potionRule.Ambrosia: Enter Divinity this turn: gain 3 Energy and triple Attack damage. Return to Neutral at the start of the next turn.
potionRule.EssenceOfDarkness: Channel potency Dark orbs for each current Orb slot (base 1 per slot). Normal channel and evoke rules apply.

relicState.openingEnergySpent: opening Energy bonus spent this combat
relicState.openingEnergyChecked: opening Energy check completed this combat
relicState.discardEnergySpent: discard Energy trigger spent this turn

effect.randomDamage_one: Deal {{damage}} damage {{count}} time, choosing a random enemy for each hit.
effect.randomDamage_other: Deal {{damage}} damage {{count}} times, choosing a random enemy for each hit.

Buffer.amountUnit: remaining damage or HP-loss events to prevent
Buffer.effect: Prevent the next positive damage or HP-loss event, then consume one charge. Fully blocked damage does not consume Buffer. Unblocked Beat of Death can consume it; each hit of a multi-hit attack is a separate event. Direct HP loss also consumes a charge, even though Block cannot absorb that HP loss.
Buffer.timing: After Block for blockable damage, before positive HP loss; persists until its charges are consumed or it is removed.

Barricade.amountUnit: presence; numeric amount is not a stack count
Barricade.effect: Keeps the owner's remaining Block at the normal turn-start clearing point. Incoming damage still spends Block; the effect creates no Block itself.
Barricade.timing: Owner turn start; persists for combat until removed.

Berserk.effect: Gain amount additional Energy at each player turn start. The card's self-Vulnerable is a separate debuff with its own duration.
Berserk.timing: Player turn start, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

Energized.amountUnit: additional Energy at the next player recharge
Energized.effect: Gain amount additional Energy at the next player energy recharge, then remove this power. Repeated applications of the same color add together; green and blue Energized remain separate powers and both trigger.
Energized.timing: Next player energy recharge, before ordinary start-of-turn draws; does not grant Energy when applied.

Brutality.amountUnit: additional cards drawn and HP lost per turn
Brutality.effect: After the normal draw, draw amount additional cards, then lose amount HP. Draw prevention and hand capacity apply to the draw; Block does not prevent the HP loss.
Brutality.timing: Player turn start after normal draw, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

DemonForm.effect: Gain amount Strength after each normal start-of-turn draw. Existing Strength remains, so gains accumulate across turns.
DemonForm.timing: Player turn start after normal draw, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

DoubleTap.effect: Each next Attack card is played a second time for free against the same target, after its original effects. Consume one charge per original Attack card; Skills and Powers keep the charges.
DoubleTap.timing: On card play; unused charges expire at player turn end.

Evolve.amountUnit: additional cards drawn per Status drawn
Evolve.effect: Drawing a Status requests amount additional draws. Curses do not trigger it. Draw prevention and hand capacity apply, and newly drawn Statuses can trigger further draws.
Evolve.timing: On Status draw while active; persists for combat.

FireBreathing.amountUnit: damage to each enemy per Status or Curse drawn
FireBreathing.effect: When a Status or Curse is drawn, deal amount THORNS damage to all enemies. Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify this damage; enemy Block and damage caps apply.
FireBreathing.timing: On Status or Curse draw while active; persists for combat.

Juggernaut.amountUnit: damage per positive Block gain event
Juggernaut.effect: Whenever the player gains positive Block, deal amount THORNS damage to a random living enemy. Separate Block gains can trigger separately. This deals damage rather than granting more Block.
Juggernaut.timing: On positive Block gain while active; persists for combat.

Rupture.amountUnit: Strength gained per qualifying self-inflicted HP-loss event
Rupture.effect: Gain amount Strength when HP is actually lost from a qualifying self-inflicted card effect, such as {{entity_card_Offering}} or {{entity_card_Brutality}}. Fully prevented HP loss supplies no gain.
Rupture.timing: On qualifying self-inflicted HP loss while active; persists for combat.

MagnetismPower.amountUnit: random Colorless cards generated per player turn
MagnetismPower.effect: Add amount random temporary Colorless cards to Hand at each turn start. They keep their ordinary costs; hand capacity applies.
MagnetismPower.timing: Player turn start from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

MayhemPower.amountUnit: top draw-pile cards automatically played per player turn
MayhemPower.effect: After normal turn draw, automatically play amount cards from the top of the remaining draw pile for free, choosing a random enemy when a target is required. Each played card keeps its own Exhaust rule.
MayhemPower.timing: Player turn start after normal draw, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

PanachePower.amountUnit: cards still to play before the next damage trigger this turn
PanachePower.effect: Every fifth card played this turn deals the stored THORNS damage to all enemies, then resets the counter to 5. The card supplies 10 damage (14 if upgraded); repeated deployment adds stored damage.
PanachePower.timing: On card play; the counter resets to 5 at player turn start, and the damage effect persists for combat.

SadisticPower.effect: When the owner applies a debuff to another entity without Artifact, deal amount THORNS damage to that target. Artifact-blocked applications supply no damage.
SadisticPower.timing: On debuff application while active; persists for combat.

Poison.amountUnit: HP lost at the next owner turn start
Poison.effect: At the owner's turn start, lose HP equal to amount, then reduce Poison by 1. Block does not prevent this loss. Artifact can block a new Poison application.
Poison.timing: Owner turn start; decreases per trigger until removed.

Focus.amountUnit: modifier to Lightning, Frost and Dark Orb amounts
Focus.effect: Adds amount to affected Orb damage or Block values, with a minimum of 0. Affects Lightning damage, Frost Block and Dark passive charge gain; Plasma Energy and the Dark Orb's already stored charge are unchanged.
Focus.timing: When affected Orb values are evaluated; persists until changed or removed.

Regeneration.amountUnit: HP healed at the next owner turn end
Regeneration.effect: Heal amount HP up to Max HP and subject to healing modifiers, then reduce the amount by 1. With 5 stacks and no modifiers, successive healing requests are 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1.
Regeneration.timing: Owner turn end, including the turn applied; decreases per trigger until removed.

DuplicationPower.effect: Each next original card is played a second time for free against the same target after its first effects, consuming one charge. Works on Attacks, Skills and Powers. Replays themselves consume no additional charge.
DuplicationPower.timing: On card play; one unused charge is lost at each round end.

Vigor.amountUnit: bonus damage per hit of the next Attack card
Vigor.effect: Adds amount to every normal damage hit and target of the next Attack card, before damage modifiers. Multiple hits consume one Vigor effect, not one stack per hit.
Vigor.timing: Consumed when an Attack card is played. Skills and Powers do not consume it.

TheBombPower.amountUnit: remaining owner turn-end ticks until the explosion
TheBombPower.effect: Decrements by 1 at each owner's turn end. At amount 1, removes this countdown and deals its stored damage to all enemies as THORNS damage. The Bomb stores 40 damage, or 50 when upgraded; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify it. Enemy Block and damage caps still apply.
TheBombPower.timing: Owner turn end, including the turn it was applied. Starts at 3, so the explosion occurs on the third turn end.

Regen.amountUnit: HP healed at each owner's turn end
Regen.effect: Heal the owner by amount at its turn end, up to Max HP. Does not decrement. {{entity_enemy_AwakenedOne}} retains it after Rebirth. This is the monster's Regenerate, distinct from the player's decreasing Regeneration effect.
Regen.timing: Owner turn end; persists until removed.

Artifact.effect: Blocks one debuff application per charge, regardless of its stack amount, then consumes one charge. Damage and adding Status cards are not debuff applications. Separate debuffs from one card are checked in execution order.
Artifact.timing: At the debuff application, not at the end of the turn. The Artifact power is removed when its last charge is consumed; ordinary debuff duration reduction does not consume charges.

Anger.effect: When the player plays a Skill, the owner gains amount Strength. {{entity_enemy_GremlinNob}} uses this power for Enrage; Attacks and Powers do not trigger it.
Anger.timing: Triggers while this power is present; its amount is not a duration.

Angry.amountUnit: Strength gained per qualifying damage hit
Angry.effect: Gains amount Strength on positive sourced damage, excluding HP-loss and thorns damage. This is different from {{entity_enemy_GremlinNob}}'s Skill-triggered Anger.
Angry.timing: Each qualifying damage hit can trigger it; zero damage does not.

BeatOfDeath.amountUnit: damage to the player per counted card
BeatOfDeath.effect: Every counted card deals this much THORNS damage to the player. Block can absorb it; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify it. {{entity_relic_Torii}}'s normal-hit reduction does not apply to this THORNS damage. It resolves after the card's own effects but before that card's final exhaust triggers {{entity_card_FeelNoPain}}. Extra actions a card queues can have their own exhaust triggers; inspect the settled result for timing-sensitive sequences.
BeatOfDeath.timing: After-use trigger, not the start of card play; persists until removed.

Confusion.effect: Whenever a card with a nonnegative combat cost is drawn, randomize that instance's combat cost to 0, 1, 2 or 3. X-cost and unplayable cards are excluded. This can make cheap cards more expensive or expensive cards cheaper. Each new draw can randomize the cost again; use the displayed hand cost.
Confusion.timing: Persists for the rest of combat; the amount is not a duration or a multiplier.

Constricted.amountUnit: Thorns damage dealt to the owner each turn end
Constricted.effect: At the owner's turn end, the original creature source deals amount Thorns damage to the owner. Block can absorb it; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not change it. Repeated applications add amount while keeping the first source. Artifact can block application and debuff removal can remove it.
Constricted.timing: Owner turn end, including the turn of application. Persists until removed; does not decrement each round.

Curiosity.amountUnit: permanent Strength gained per player Power card
Curiosity.effect: Whenever the player plays a Power card, grant the owner this much Strength. Attacks and Skills do not trigger it. {{entity_enemy_AwakenedOne}} removes Curiosity at first-phase lethal damage.
Curiosity.timing: Card-play trigger; persists until removed, not a turn countdown.

CurlUp.effect: On the first qualifying damage hit, gains amount Block after damage and removes Curl Up. Requires positive damage, a living owner and a damage source.
CurlUp.timing: Triggers once, not on every hit. A lethal hit does not gain Block.

Dexterity.effect: Adds amount to Block gained from cards before other Block modifiers. Does not add Block by itself.
Dexterity.timing: Persists until another effect changes or removes it.

DexterityDown.amountUnit: Dexterity to subtract at owner's turn end
DexterityDown.effect: Subtract the stored amount from the owner's then-current Dexterity, then remove this power. Already gained Block stays. This is a fixed subtraction, not a reset; Artifact can block application of this debuff.
DexterityDown.timing: Owner's turn end, once; {{entity_potion_SpeedPotion}}'s temporary Dexterity expires this way.

DrawReduction.amountUnit: cards subtracted from the normal start-of-turn draw
DrawReduction.effect: Reduce the owner's normal turn-start draw by amount. Does not reduce card-effect draws such as {{entity_card_PommelStrike}} or {{entity_card_ShrugItOff}}.
DrawReduction.timing: At end of round, reduce amount by 1; skip the first decrement while newly applied, so the next normal draw is reduced.

Entangle.effect: Prevents playing Attack cards while active. Skills and Powers remain playable.
Entangle.timing: Removed at the end of the affected player's turn.

Explosive.effect: At 1, kill the owner and then deal 30 Thorns damage to the player. Player Block absorbs this damage; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify it. At higher amounts, decrease by 1. Killing the owner earlier prevents its countdown from running.
Explosive.timing: Runs during the owner's turn, queued after its move actions and before the next monster's move actions, not at end of round.

Fading.effect: After the owner's queued move, decrease by 1; at 1 or less, kill the owner instead. Its current attack still executes before disappearance. You can win by surviving until this countdown completes.
Fading.timing: Runs during the owner's turn after its move actions, before the next monster's move actions. Does not tick at end of round.

Flight.effect: While present, halves normal damage before Block, rounded down. Each normal hit that causes positive HP loss to a surviving owner and has a source removes 1 Flight; multiple hits from one card count separately. Fully blocked hits, Thorns and HP-loss effects do not remove Flight; Thorns and HP-loss effects also bypass its damage reduction. At zero Flight, a {{entity_enemy_Byrd}} loses flying status and immediately replaces its current intent with Stunned.
Flight.timing: At the owner's turn start, remaining Flight restores to its stored initial amount if it was not completely removed. Grounded {{entity_enemy_Byrd}}s regain Flight only when executing Go Airborne.

Frail.effect: Reduces Block gained from cards by 25%, rounded down. More stacks extend duration, not the reduction.
Frail.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, unless the newly-applied flag skips that tick.

GenericStrengthUp.effect: At the end of each round, gain Strength equal to amount if amount is positive. The effect itself persists and does not decrement. It does not grant Strength immediately when applied.
GenericStrengthUp.timing: End-of-round power hook, after the monsters have executed their moves; the gained Strength affects later attacks.

Hex.amountUnit: Dazed cards added per non-Attack card played
Hex.effect: When the owner plays a non-Attack card, including a Skill or Power, add amount unupgraded Dazed to random positions in the owner's draw pile. Dazed is unplayable and Ethereal. Attacks do not trigger this effect.
Hex.timing: Card play; persists until removed. Does not decrement each round. Artifact can block its application and debuff removal can remove it.

Intangible.amountUnit: remaining owner turns of monster Intangible
Intangible.effect: While positive, cap each final damage or direct HP-loss instance above 1 to 1. Multi-hit attacks still apply a separate capped instance for each hit. This is the monster version; the player's version has stable ID IntangiblePlayer.
Intangible.timing: Decreases by 1 at the owner's turn end, unless just applied skips that tick.

IntangiblePlayer.effect: While positive, cap each final damage or direct HP-loss instance above 1 to 1. Multi-hit attacks still apply a separate capped instance for each hit. Normal damage can then be absorbed by Block; Intangible itself does not create Block.
IntangiblePlayer.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, after the enemy turn. One stack gained during your turn protects through that enemy turn; additional stacks extend duration.

Invincible.amountUnit: remaining HP damage allowance before the owner's next turn start
Invincible.effect: Caps cumulative HP damage, including HP loss. Damage consumes the remaining allowance; at zero, further damage is prevented. The stored reset cap restores the allowance at the owner's turn start, before start-of-turn damage such as Poison. The enemy definition supplies the initial allowance for the encounter's Ascension; the combat reading supplies the current remaining allowance.
Invincible.timing: Resets at the owner's turn start, not after every hit or at player turn end.

LoseStrength.amountUnit: Strength to subtract at owner's turn end
LoseStrength.effect: Subtract the stored amount from the owner's then-current Strength, then remove this power. This is a fixed subtraction, not a reset of Strength; other Strength gains remain except for that subtraction. Artifact can block application of this debuff.
LoseStrength.timing: Owner's turn end, once; not a recurring loss each round.

Malleable.amountUnit: Block gained by the next qualifying hit; stored base is the reset amount
Malleable.effect: Each nonlethal normal hit that causes positive HP loss queues Block equal to the current amount, then immediately increases the amount by 1. Fully blocked hits, lethal hits, Thorns and HP-loss effects do not trigger it. Counts hits, not cards; queued Block resolves at its existing queue position.
Malleable.timing: After the monster's turn ends, the amount resets to its stored base. Does not lose duration each round.

Minion.effect: Marks the owner as a minion and excludes it from unique kill-reward triggers. Its enemy behavior determines leader-death escape; in the {{entity_enemy_GremlinLeader}} encounter, other non-dying allies escape when the leader dies.
Minion.timing: Persistent marker; encounter behavior handles escape.

NextTurnBlock.amountUnit: accumulated Block to gain at the owner's next turn start
NextTurnBlock.effect: At the owner's next turn start, gain Block equal to amount, then remove this power. Multiple applications add to the same pending amount. The delayed Block does not protect during the turn when this power is applied.
NextTurnBlock.timing: Owner turn-start power hook, after normal Block clearing; consumed in one trigger.

NoBlock.amountUnit: remaining round-end ticks of card Block prevention
NoBlock.effect: Sets calculated Block from cards to 0. Block gained by powers and relics, such as {{entity_card_FeelNoPain}} and {{entity_card_Metallicize}}, still applies. Existing Block is not removed by application. Artifact can block this debuff.
NoBlock.timing: Decreases by 1 at each round end, including the round it was applied. {{entity_card_PanicButton}} applies 2, affecting further card Block this turn and next turn.

NoDraw.amountUnit: presence; not a numeric stack count
NoDraw.effect: Prevents further card draw while active, including card and power triggers such as {{entity_card_DarkEmbrace}} and {{entity_card_Evolve}}. It does not prevent adding generated cards to Hand or moving cards into Hand without drawing.
NoDraw.timing: Removed at the owner's turn end. {{entity_card_BattleTrance}} draws its cards before applying this power.

PainfulStabs.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
PainfulStabs.effect: Whenever the owner inflicts positive HP damage other than THORNS damage, add 1 Wound to the player's discard pile. Fully blocked hits add none; multiple damaging hits each add a Wound.

PlatedArmor.effect: Gain amount Block at turn end. Each incoming normal hit that actually loses HP from another entity removes 1 Plated Armor. Fully blocked hits, THORNS and HP-loss damage do not remove a stack. Removing the last stack stuns {{entity_enemy_ShelledParasite}}.
PlatedArmor.timing: Turn-end Block and on-HP-loss reduction; not a duration countdown.

Rage.amountUnit: Block gained per Attack card played
Rage.effect: When the player plays an Attack card, the owner gains Block equal to amount (at least 0). Triggers once per card, not once per hit; Skills and Powers do not trigger it.
Rage.timing: Active while present; removed at the end of the player turn. Amount is not a duration.

Reactive.amountUnit: presence flag (-1 is the runtime sentinel)
Reactive.effect: Each normal hit with a real source that causes positive HP loss while the owner survives queues a new monster move roll. Fully blocked and lethal hits, Thorns and HP-loss effects do not trigger it. Multi-hit attacks can cause multiple rolls.
Reactive.timing: After qualifying damage; persists until removed. The resulting visible intention replaces the earlier intention, so inspect it again after attacking.

Ritual.effect: Repeatedly grants amount Strength; the displayed amount is growth per trigger, not current Strength.
Ritual.timing: Player-controlled Ritual triggers at end of player turn. Monster Ritual triggers at end of round and skips its initial trigger.

Shackled.amountUnit: Strength restored at the owner's turn end
Shackled.effect: At the end of the owner's turn, apply amount Strength to the owner only if amount is positive, then remove Shackled. Non-positive amounts restore no Strength; Shackled is still removed. The Strength reduction is a separate effect, not performed by Shackled itself.
Shackled.timing: Removed at the owner's turn end, not an end-of-round duration counter.

SharpHide.amountUnit: Thorns damage per Attack card played
SharpHide.effect: When the player plays an Attack card, the owner deals amount Thorns damage to the player. Triggers once per card, not once per hit; Skills and Powers do not trigger it. Player Block can absorb this damage.
SharpHide.timing: Triggers only while present; no automatic round decay. Guardian removes it when leaving Defensive Mode.

Shifting.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Shifting.effect: Whenever normal or Thorns damage causes positive HP loss to the owner, apply that much negative Strength and an equal Shackled effect. Fully blocked hits and direct HP-loss effects do not trigger it. This reduces current attack damage, potentially to 0. Artifact can block the negative Strength application and prevents the matching Shackled application.
Shifting.timing: Strength reduction lasts through the owner's attack. Shackled restores the reduced Strength at the owner's turn end and removes itself; Shifting remains present.

Slow.amountUnit: card-play counter for the current round
Slow.effect: Player Attack card damage against this owner is multiplied by 1 + 0.1 times amount. Skills and Powers also increase the counter when played, so earlier setup cards can amplify later Attacks.
Slow.timing: Each player card play adds 1. At the end of the round, reset the amount to 0 and keep the power present. A turn-start reading of 0 is the reset counter; it can grow again during that turn.

Split.effect: For a living Large Slime or {{entity_enemy_SlimeBoss}}, reaching half Max HP or below replaces the current intent with Split. Each child's current and Max HP equal the parent's remaining HP at split execution. More damage before splitting reduces the children; killing the parent prevents splitting.
Split.timing: Checked after damage; Split executes on the enemy turn. Medium and Small Slimes do not split.

SporeCloud.effect: On death, applies amount Vulnerable to the player. This increases incoming attack damage; it does not apply Weak or reduce the player's attacks.
SporeCloud.timing: Death trigger is skipped when the battle is already ending. The amount here is the application size, not the player's remaining Vulnerable duration.

Strength.effect: Amount is signed: +2 adds 2 attack damage per hit, -2 subtracts 2, before multipliers. Strength reduction works from 0 Strength into negative Strength. {{entity_card_HeavyBlade}} scales this signed bonus with its card multiplier.
Strength.timing: Persists until another effect changes or removes it.

Surrounded.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Surrounded.effect: Targeting an enemy with a card turns the player toward it. An enemy behind the player deals 50% more attack damage. Untargeted cards do not turn the player. Actual damage uses facing and position; Back Attack is the visible marker. Ends when the surrounding pair is broken.
Surrounded.timing: Facing changes at targeted card play; remains while surrounded.

BackAttack.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
BackAttack.effect: Marks an enemy behind the Surrounded player. Its attacks deal 50% more damage. Targeted cards can change facing; actual damage follows facing, and this display marker refreshes when the card queue settles.
BackAttack.timing: Derived from player facing while Surrounded, not a stack-based damage modifier.

Thievery.amountUnit: Gold stolen per stealing move, capped by available Gold
Thievery.effect: The thief's stealing moves take Gold before attack damage; Block does not prevent theft. Killing the thief recovers its stolen Gold in rewards; escape does not.
Thievery.timing: Stealing moves only; not an automatic effect on every hit or turn. No round decay.

Thorns.effect: When attacked by another entity with normal damage, deal this much THORNS damage to the attacker, even when Block absorbs the hit. Multi-hit attacks trigger once per hit. THORNS and HP-loss damage do not trigger retaliation; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify retaliation damage.

TimeWarp.amountUnit: card counter toward 12, retained across turns
TimeWarp.effect: Each counted player card increments the counter. The 12th forces the player's turn to end, resets the counter to 0, and gives all living enemies 2 permanent Strength. Ending a normal turn does not reset it. Potions are not card plays.
TimeWarp.timing: Card-play trigger and forced-end sequence; persists across turns.

Unawakened.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Unawakened.effect: {{entity_enemy_AwakenedOne}}'s first phase. First lethal damage starts Rebirth instead of final death: remove debuffs, Curiosity, Unawakened and Shackled; preserve positive Strength and Regenerate. Rebirth restores full HP without attacking; Dark Echo follows. The transition belongs to the monster's damage handler.
Unawakened.timing: Removed immediately at first-phase lethal damage.

Vulnerable.effect: Increases attack damage received, normally by 50%. More stacks extend duration, not the multiplier. {{entity_relic_PaperFrog}} and {{entity_relic_OddMushroom}} can change the multiplier.
Vulnerable.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, unless the newly-applied flag skips that tick. The displayed amount is remaining duration, not the original application.

Weak.effect: Reduces attack damage dealt, normally by 25%. Paper Crane makes enemy Weak stronger. More stacks extend duration, not the multiplier.
Weak.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, unless the newly-applied flag skips that tick.

Combust.amountUnit: damage to each enemy; separate self HP loss is stored alongside it
Combust.effect: At player turn end, first lose the stored self HP loss, then deal amount non-Attack damage to each enemy. Block does not prevent the self HP loss. Each additional deployment adds its damage and 1 to self HP loss; this loss can trigger Rupture.
Combust.timing: Player turn end; persists for the rest of combat. Damage and self HP loss stack independently.

Corruption.amountUnit: presence; not a numeric stack count
Corruption.effect: While active, Skills cost 0 and Exhaust when played, including Skills that normally do not Exhaust. It does not draw cards or give Energy. Attacks and Powers keep their own costs and destinations. Owning the Corruption card is not the same as having this active power.
Corruption.timing: Takes effect when deployed and persists for the rest of combat. Additional Corruption applications do not multiply this effect.

DarkEmbrace.effect: While active, whenever any card is Exhausted, draw amount cards. Multiple deployed copies add their amounts: amount 2 draws 2 per Exhaust. Does not give Energy. No Draw prevents the draw; no further draw is queued once combat has ended.
DarkEmbrace.timing: On Exhaust, after deployment; persists for the rest of combat. Merely owning or holding the card does not activate this trigger.

FeelNoPain.effect: While active, whenever any card is Exhausted, gain amount Block. Multiple deployed copies add their amounts. This trigger does not draw cards or give Energy; Dexterity and Frail do not modify this power's Block.
FeelNoPain.timing: On Exhaust, after deployment; persists for the rest of combat. The Block itself follows ordinary Block lifetime rules.

FlameBarrier.effect: When another entity attacks the owner with normal damage, deal amount THORNS damage to the attacker, even when Block absorbs the hit. Multi-hit attacks trigger once per hit. Self damage, THORNS and HP-loss damage do not trigger it. Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify retaliation damage.
FlameBarrier.timing: On-attacked trigger; removed at the start of the owner's next turn. Multiple applications add their amounts until that removal.

Metallicize.amountUnit: Block gained at each owner's turn end
Metallicize.effect: Gain amount Block at the end of the owner's turn. Does not decay each round; {{entity_enemy_Lagavulin}} removes its sleeping {{entity_card_Metallicize}} when it wakes.
Metallicize.timing: Owner turn end, not on card play or damage. For the player, end-of-turn relic checks such as {{entity_relic_Orichalcum}} happen before this Block gain; this gain then precedes queued end-of-turn Status and Curse effects.

Regrow.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Regrow.effect: {{entity_enemy_Darkling}}s enter half-death at 0 HP while another {{entity_enemy_Darkling}} is still alive. Their powers are cleared, their current move becomes the idle Count, and they cannot be targeted. After Count, Reincarnate restores floor(Max HP / 2) HP, revives the monster and reinstalls Life Link. Bringing all {{entity_enemy_Darkling}}s to 0 HP before any revives kills the group permanently.
Regrow.timing: Half-death and group defeat are owned by {{entity_enemy_Darkling}}'s death handler; revival occurs on its Reincarnate move. This is not an end-of-turn regeneration amount.

ModeShift.amountUnit: remaining HP damage to trigger Defensive Mode
ModeShift.effect: Actual HP loss reduces the remaining amount; damage absorbed by Block does not. Reaching the threshold replaces the current intent with Close Up, removes Mode Shift and grants Defensive Block. The next threshold increases each time; see the Guardian definition for difficulty-specific amounts.
ModeShift.timing: Active in Offensive Mode; restored with the new threshold after Twin Slam. No round decay.

key.chestOpportunities: While Sapphire is missing, an opened normal treasure chest offers the key instead of its linked relic, including a chest reached through a question-mark room. Normal Acts 1-3 each have a fixed treasure row at map y=8. Parallel nodes on that row are alternative paths: you visit one, not all of them. If you defer Sapphire, a later Act's fixed chest is another opportunity; after the Act 3 chest, the existence of a future random question-mark chest is uncertain. Base chest-size and relic-tier rolls use the same rules in Acts 1-3; the later relic's identity is revealed when its chest opens. Use the current chest's displayed rewards to choose.
key.rubyOpportunities: While Ruby is missing and Act 4 is enabled, Recall is available at campfires in normal Acts 1-3. Each of those Acts has a fixed final campfire row at map y=14 before its Boss. Deferring Ruby at the last campfire of Act 1 or Act 2 leaves the later Act's final campfire as another opportunity. Recall uses that campfire's action instead of another available recovery or improvement.
key.timing: Heart access requires all three keys before completing Act 3. Collected keys persist between Acts.
key.emeraldRewards: The Emerald Key and the elite's other rewards can all be claimed.
key.emeraldOpportunities: While Emerald is missing and Act 4 is enabled, each normal Act (1, 2 and 3) marks one elite as a burning elite. Win that fight and claim its key reward. Deferring Emerald to a later Act leaves that Act's burning elite as another opportunity; use the published map to check its route and preparation windows.

combat.blockLifetime: Block normally clears at the start of its owner's turn: player Block before the next player turn, and each enemy's Block before that enemy acts. End-of-turn Block such as Metallicize protects until that owner's next turn. Barricade retains Block, and Blur preserves player Block for its duration. Otherwise player Calipers loses up to 15 Block at the usual clear point.
combat.shopRemoval: Shop card removal: each shop permits only one removal. Base price is 75 Gold + 25 per previous shop removal in this run. Skipping removal leaves the count and base price unchanged. Completing a shop removal increments the count by one, adding 25 Gold to the future base price. Each shop's displayed price includes its current relic price modifiers.

query.help:
Current event or decision option effects: info (no arguments).
Mechanics queries: info <power, enemy, card, relic, potion or encounter name>, info card <name>, info relic <name>, info potion <name>, info enemy <name>, info encounter <name>, info power <name>, info M0, info player, info powers, info rules, info rules preparation, info transition <HP>, info keys or info <key name>.
Use full English names or stable IDs. Names match exactly, ignoring spaces and case; power names take precedence. Missing explanation coverage is reported as Unknown.
Enemy definitions use the current run's ascension. Encounter definitions list fixed members and weighted random starting slots, then member mechanics. Card definitions honor an explicit + or +N upgrade suffix (no suffix means base); combat readings give current hand values.
